allowed_after_pass: retain the analytic inverse as a deterministic physical profile-compiler and diagnostic primitive
use exact forward/inverse consistency in later bounded parameter fitting or runtime conformance
forbidden: use iterative optimization, clipping or silent projection to manufacture invertibility
call the generic print witness a calibrated stock, process, printer or scanner
infer RGB stock response from neutral Digital LAD
photographic fitting, visual promotion or product integration
